ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with high-frequency, high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters. Calculated white-to-black pixel ratio approximately 1:6.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white annular and circular blobs distributed across both lobes; highest density occurs on the distal-lateral regions and along the trailing edges; medial regions near the notch show lower density of high-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 68 degrees; vertical depth of the notch is approximately 12% of the total vertical extent of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; frequent micro-peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth; distal tips show jagged, irregular terminations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the central notch to the distal tips; trailing edge follows a generally horizontal but irregular path before curving upward at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark ventral surface; high density in the upper third of both lobes; diameter of individual clusters ranges from 5 to 25 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions observed in the medial-lower region of the left lobe; faint diagonal linear marks visible on the lower section of the right lobe near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization scarring characterized by white annular rings covering roughly 30-40% of the visible fluke area; irregular white pigment patches on the upper margin of the left lobe and distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white patch on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as an irregular solid mass rather than a rosette.
